title: Can I BEAT DougDoug's Chess Variant? (Choice Chess)
summary: DougDoug's 'Three Choice Chess' website: online 3-minute games vs humans where every few turns the player to move picks one of three random effects (70+ effects) that change the game. Examples seen: Hobbit Slaughter (only pawns can die for 2-4 moves), Early Promotion (pawns promote on the 6th rank), March of the Ponguins (all pawns advance one square if empty, no captures), Pawns Learn Strength (pawns push pieces forward, chain reactions, pieces pushed off board are removed). Some effects are instant, others timed/delayed. Tony wins one game.
rules: Periodically (every few turns; White first after move 1, then Black) the player is offered 3 random effect cards and must choose one.
Effects are instant or last/kick in after N moves; 70+ effects in the pool.
